verdict.rationale: Audience syncs run on a schedule or when data changes, and CDC sends only added, changed and removed rows, so members enter and exit destination lists incrementally. Hightouch also claims real-time syncs to 300+ destinations, including ad platforms (with match-boosted identifiers) and engagement tools like Braze. Missing for 10: documented sync latency or frequency figures that substantiate near-real-time audience membership updates, explicit docs on how audience exits map to ad-platform list removals, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time audience activation.
